definitions: Covered thinly with gold leaf or gold paint.
Given a specious or attractive appearance to disguise its true nature.
Made to look attractive or desirable.
examples: The frame was gilded with 24-carat gold.
He gilded the truth to make his story more appealing.
The company gilded its financial reports.
pastTenses: gilded (past simple), gilded (present perfect), gilded (past perfect)
